data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Idonai', which means 'Idol', but in Christian contexts, it is interpreted as 'God's grace' or 'kindness'. It was believed that Idonai, in its Christian interpretation, was a name that would remind its bearer of the divine grace that God extends to all of humanity, encouraging humility and gratitude.
